sparql.title: Linked Data & SPARQL Endpoint
sparql.description: Materialized RDF projection (Oxigraph) and read-only SPARQL 1.1 Protocol Endpoint.
sparql.unreachableHelp: Oxigraph is enabled but not responding at the configured URL. Please check whether the container is running and the Docker profile 'rdf' is active.
sparql.rebuildDescription: Synchronizes all published records of all 7 core types (objects, entities, places, occurrences, procedures, collections, storage locations) atomically from PostgreSQL into Oxigraph.
sparql.rebuildConfirm: Rebuild the entire triple store from PostgreSQL? This process runs asynchronously in the background.
sparql.rebuildSuccess: Rebuild queued – synchronization is running in the background.

presenceLock.title: Editing Lock (Presence Lock)
presenceLock.description: Controls what happens when a record is already being edited by someone else.
presenceLock.warningDescription: other people see a hint but can still edit the record.
presenceLock.blockingDescription: while the record is open, other people cannot save it.

autoPurge.title: Trash & automatic cleanup
autoPurge.description: Deleted records (objects, entities, places, occurrences, collections, storage locations) first go to the trash, where they can be restored. When automatic cleanup is enabled, they are permanently deleted after the configured retention period (nightly background job).
autoPurge.daysHint: Records that have been in the trash longer than this many days are permanently deleted on the next run.

startseite.title: Homepage
startseite.description: Which content blocks make up the portal homepage, and in which order they appear.
startseite.empty: No blocks configured yet. The homepage will show only the welcome text.
startseite.curatedHint: Shows the featured objects maintained under "Portal & Institution".

terminologie.title: Terminology
terminologie.description: Customize the core-type terminology per installation (e.g. "Work" instead of "Object"). Presentation only – internal names, API routes, and permissions stay unchanged.

detailLayout.metaRowHint: Applies uniformly to all detail pages.
detailLayout.metaLabelUppercaseHint: Affects metadata and relations on all detail pages.
detailLayout.title: Detail page layout
detailLayout.sidebarHint: Applies to all detail pages (objects, entities, places, occurrences). On small screens, media/main content always come first.
detailLayout.iiifButton: Show IIIF manifest button on the object detail page
detailLayout.iiifButtonHint: For objects with images, shows a link to the IIIF manifest and a copy action, without icons.

dangerZone.vocabDescription: Either removes all terms of a vocabulary (keeping the vocabulary shell and linked schema fields) or permanently deletes the entire vocabulary. System vocabularies (media_types, relation_types) can be emptied, but cannot be deleted as a whole.
dangerZone.vocabScopeFullSystemDisabled: Delete entire vocabulary (system vocabulary – not allowed)
dangerZone.vocabSummaryTerms: {{count}} terms will be deleted. The vocabulary itself will be kept.
dangerZone.vocabSummaryFull: Vocabulary "{{name}}" and {{count}} terms will be permanently deleted.
dangerZone.vocabReferencingFieldsWarning: Note: {{count}} active field definitions reference this vocabulary and will also be hidden when deleting the entire vocabulary.
dangerZone.vocabSuccessFullWithFields: Vocabulary "{{name}}" ({{count}} terms) was deleted; {{fields}} linked field definitions were hidden.
dangerZone.schemaDescription: Hides field definitions but does not delete any records or metadata. To edit a field again later, recreate it in the schema editor with the same technical name; the stored values are then shown again. The system field

portal.subtitle: Subtitle
portal.navigationHint: Only enabled types appear as a separate menu item in the portal. Direct links remain accessible.

search.reconcileStarted: Reconciliation started – running in the background. Refresh the page shortly to see the result.
search.indexStatusDescription: Compares the number of records in the database and the search index. Differences are checked daily and reindexed once they reach the configured threshold.
search.reindexStarted: Reindexing started – running in the background.
search.title: Search & indexing
search.description: After schema changes or data imports, the search index must be updated manually. Reindexing runs asynchronously in the background.

idno.description: An ID schema with placeholders can be defined per primary type. When a new record is created, the next ID is suggested automatically.
idno.placeholders: Placeholders: {counter} – sequential number | {counter:05d} – zero-padded | {year} – current year | {type} – type abbreviation (obj/ent/pla/occ/pro)
idno.patternHint: If set, manually entered IDs are checked against this pattern.

authorities.reachable: Reachable – {{count}} hits for the test query.
authorities.description: Authority sources for authority fields and vocabulary term lookups. Disabled sources are no longer offered for new links; links already stored remain unchanged.
